newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Formosa group shares up on strategic buy.
newsitem.headline: Formosa group shares up on strategic buy.

text.p: Three key members of Taiwan's Formosa Plastics group rose at mid-morning on Thursday on what brokers termed "strategic buying" aimed to boost sentiment.
With 75 minutes left, Formosa Plastics rose T$1 or 1.45 percent to T$70, Formosa Chemical Fiber gained 70 cents or 1.62 percent to T$43.9 and Nan Ya Plastics rose 50 cents or 0.76 percent to T$66.5.
"It's strategic buying by major players, trying to buy the three blue chips to boost the overall upward momentum," said Yuanta Securities analyst Tank Hung.
The three shares also lagged recent gains, Hung said.

"But this strategy (of buying blue chips) does not seem to be working because most investors still hesitate to increase their holdings when the index is reaching the six-year resistance around 7,200 points," Hung said.
